notes.title: Difficulty Update 2.0
notes.content:
Preparing to release new content starting with the first difficulty update.  To raise the difficulty go to settings and change it from one to two.  In the new difficulty when returning from battles to the force organization screen troops may permanently "die" and get removed from the army roster.  A warning will post about which troops names and classes have been lost.

In testing this has made the game much more engaging.

Thanks for your support! For more information check out the blog at -

https://www.errantsquireslancergames.com/blog

- Errantsquire

notes.title: The First Steam Achievements are Live!
notes.content:
We here at Lancer Entertainment are happy to announce that Steam Achievements are now live in Six Aspects!  Currently players can receive an achievement for each stage that they complete.  There are some stages that are a little more difficult to get to than others so keep that in mind!

We are also leaning forward in the coming summer months to finish as many levels as we can and create a more robust dialogue system so that players can make some meaningful choices throughout their experience.  It's our goal to keep engaging players while respecting their time.  The game has always built on the idea that games should be fun experiences that aren't just meaningless grind and time sinks.

We hope that you believe what we do as the project keeps getting better!

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
First published build to Steam!  This has been a very long road and I'm so happy to have finally made it to this point.  I can't wait to see all the feedback to make this the best game that it can be!  Check out some of the game play while you wait for the 22 Apr 2022 release!
